dogecoin.text:
It was not also because RH was offering no possibility for holders to withdraw their #Doge. The #Dogecoin bought on the platform became just an empty speculative assets, with all the risks involved with this.

Which is why RH adding wallets, in a proper way, is crucial for Doge.

@iamthekeyBTC I think that if you look at Elon's tweets, he was always approaching Dogecoin from an angle of fun. The "hustle" bit never seemed inappropriate to me, and it is perfectly in line with what the speculative side of this market is: gambling.

Then, Robinhood allowed the *extended* #wallstreetbets crowd to pivot their money with a couple of clicks into Dogecoin. 

This was huge. Like it or not, #wallstreetbets brought sentiment into the market, and THIS market is built entirely on that.

First, Robinhood has provided such a streamlined and user-friendly experience to people new to crypto that many who never bought crypto bought it for the first time on their platform. #Dogecoin is a gateway to crypto for many, and this is why the "marriage" with RH worked so well

But everything lives in a gray area, dear shibes. Because on the other hand, there is little doubt, having seen also their IPO data and their wallets, that Robinhood was a key factor in #Dogecoin's price explosion last year. This happened for several reasons.

More reading for the #Dogecoin community.

- Investopedia on PFOF: https://t.co/GMvt3FRLUU
- Investopedia on "How does Robinhood make money": https://t.co/f1TnMM9vvH
- Reuters on the same topic: https://t.co/Iv14lV51OB

Robinhood relies heavily on PFOF and crypto for their profits. In Q2 (the best quarter for their crypto division, so far), 50% of their revenue came from crypto, and 65% of that came from Dogecoin transactions they routed through their partners.

https://t.co/dM9EKIZ801

Additionally, and this is a CRITICAL point, since all your orders are routed through market makers, your activity becomes valuable data, which can be analyzed, interpreted, and used by third parties such as Genesis to create models to predict and influence the market. #Dogecoin

According to many critics, those setting the price when PFOF is involved, are, in practice, the largest brokers.

Genesis Trading, for example, one of Barry Silbert's companies, and one of the world's largest crypto liquidity providers. #Dogecoin

In simple words, you are paying hidden fees when buying #Dogecoin on RH, and it might be difficult to figure out if this is more convenient than a traditional fee-based trading model. 

For sure, it is even less transparent than the already obscure mechanisms behind exchanges.

It is more problematic because the crypto market is, as we know, a wild place. 

Exchanges and liquidity providers are vastly unregulated, and there is no tool to measure how honest market makers are when engaging in practices like PFOF. #Dogecoin

Important: @RobinhoodApp seems "free to use", and this is attractive to many. But most of their revenue comes from routing your trades through market makers, in a model called Payment for Order Flow.

Well known to the #wallstreetbets crowd; not so much to #Dogecoin holders.
